description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery depicting a land parcel, likely a semi-natural grassland area with scattered woody plants, delineated by an irregular blue polygon. In this composite, healthy vegetation appears in shades of red, with denser vegetation (e.g., forests, dense scrub) showing as bright red, such as the areas outside and immediately adjacent to the blue boundary. Within the blue-outlined parcel, the land cover is lighter and mottled, with numerous scattered darker spots across a lighter background, indicating a mix of grassland and individual woody plants or small scrub clusters. This appearance is consistent with descriptions of "inhomogeneous appearance" and "presence of scrub and trees inside grassland area" from the surrounding document context, which refers to semi-natural grasslands with woody plants. This type of imagery is used for Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) land use/land cover (LULC) classification, potentially within regions like Extremadura, Spain, similar to examples cited in the document context.
